recommendation_summary: The reply says to build a local script now. It reads the client's ordered code list and the folder of final JPEGs, matches each file by its code prefix, and copies the files into a numbered delivery folder in the client's order. It renders the contact-sheet PDF from that same order and flags codes that match no file or more than one. AI tagging, semantic search and the cloud review portal are put off until there is an archive to search or browser comments to collect, and only after the handoff is automated. The reply offers to write the script next. All requirements are met by the local approach.
note: The local script follows the client's code order and defers the DAM stack to a named future need, but the reply has none of the four labelled record lines, so all four checks fail.
